description: Header file defining the TrustStoreNSS class, which implements trust store functionality using NSS for certificate trust management, including trust settings, debug data, and certificate listing.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS
classes.description: Implements a trust store using NSS, supporting trust settings, issuer retrieval, and certificate listing.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ResultDebugData
classes.description: Holds debug data related to trust store results, including trust settings and slot filtering.

classes.name: TrustStoreNSS::ListCertsResult
classes.description: Represents a certificate and its trust status for listing purposes.

methods.name: TrustStoreNSS
methods.description: Constructor initializing trust store with system trust and user slot trust settings.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: ListCertsIgnoringNSSRoots
methods.description: Lists certificates ignoring NSS root certificates.
